verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs state you can create your first agent with a single command, which matches the core of the story. Its official docs MCP server and embedded package docs let coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor understand the framework. However, the evidence never names the CLI or template, never describes what the command scaffolds, and never shows a coding agent running it. missing for 10: named official CLI/template and its command syntax, description of the scaffolded project structure, documentation of coding-agent-driven scaffolding, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a coding agent scaffold a new agent project from an official CLI or template in one command

citations.quote: Create your first agent with a single command and start building.
It works with Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex or any tool that supports MCP.
